title: refactor(plugin-designer): the designer forms pick with the shared Select (objectui#11865)
body:
Part of #11865

Clause-②: no

Four plugin-designer controls were browser-native selects. They now use the shared Radix `Select` (`packages/components/src/ui/select`), the control the card's earlier slices moved the console's other pickers to (objectui#11934, objectui#11976, objectui#11990, objectui#11995, objectui#12000, objectui#12005). This PR is slice j of claim `6069665700` and converts four source files:

- `packages/plugin-designer/src/FieldDesigner.tsx`: the field list's type filter;
- `packages/plugin-designer/src/DataModelDesigner.tsx`: the type picker on each field row of an entity card;
- `packages/plugin-designer/src/BrandingEditor.tsx`: the font family;
- `packages/plugin-designer/src/AppCreationWizard.tsx`: the basic step's template.

## What changed

- Each file has one module-private picker, in the shape of `CreatePicker` and `RulePicker`: `TypeFilterPicker`, `FieldTypePicker`, `FontPicker` and `TemplatePicker`. Nothing new is exported.
- Items carry option indexes. So "All Types", "Default (System)" and "None" (value `''`) need no empty `SelectItem`.
- A stored value no option carries gets an item of its own, labelled with the value. Picking it writes nothing. This applies to the field type, the font and the template. The type filter is component state that only a pick sets, so it has no such value.
- Each pick reaches the same callback with the same value the native control's `change` carried:
  - the filter still sets `''` or the type;
  - the field type still goes through `handleFieldTypeChange`;
  - the font still writes `fontFamily: font || undefined`;
  - the template still writes `{ template }`.
- The type filter keeps its six category headings. Each native optgroup is now a `SelectGroup` headed by a `SelectLabel`.
- The font and template triggers carry the `id` their label's `htmlFor` names, and `disabled={readOnly}` now goes to the primitive.
- Two companions in `DataModelDesigner.tsx` keep what the native control did there. Without them the swap regresses.
  - **Clicks.** The trigger and the open list stop click propagation, so a click or a pick does not select the entity card. The native control stopped its own click, and its list sent the page no events. The Radix list renders in a portal, but React still bubbles its events through the card.
  - **Keys.** The canvas shortcut guard skipped `INPUT`, `TEXTAREA` and `SELECT` targets. It now also skips a `role="combobox"` target. Without that, Delete on the focused trigger deleted the selected entity, and Escape cleared the selection.

## Files

- The four source files above.
- `packages/plugin-designer/src/__tests__/designerForms.sharedSelect-11865.test.tsx`: the new pin (98 tests).
- Two suites read the type filter's native option values. They now read the open list by label:
  - `FieldDesigner.choiceTypesHidden-11253.test.tsx`;
  - `FieldDesigner.formulaControlRetired.test.tsx`.
- `.changeset/11865-j-designer-forms-shared-select.md`: a patch for `@object-ui/plugin-designer`.

## Readings against the dispatch hypotheses

- **H1, value parity: holds.**
  - A scratch probe on base `902fbe190` drove each native select with a `change` event for every option, using the pin's fixtures.
  - The pin compares 48 write rows as JSON text: 22 field types, 20 font rows over two starting brandings, and 6 template rows. All 48 equal the probe's base reads.
  - "Default (System)" writes the `fontFamily` key as `undefined`, as base did. A `toStrictEqual` row pins that.
  - The type filter writes component state, so its pin compares the rows each pick shows. With one field per type, each type option shows that field alone and "All Types" shows all 27, as the probe read on base.
  - The probe's `change` event also fired for the current option, which a browser's native select does not do. So the re-pick rows ("writes nothing") pin the primitive.
- **H2, names, keyboard and read-only.**
  - Names: base reads "Font Family" and "Template" through the label's `htmlFor`, and head reads the same. Those two pins are green on base too, by design.
  - The type filter and the field-type picker had no accessible name on base: no label and no `aria-label`, so the probe read `''`. There is no name to keep, and none is added here (see Acceptance notes).
  - Keyboard: Enter opens the field-type and template pickers, and Enter on an option selects it. Pinned.
  - Read-only, as on base:
    - font and template: the trigger is disabled through the primitive;
    - type filter: stays enabled, since it filters and writes nothing;
    - data model: a read-only field row shows its type as text, with no picker.
    All four are pinned.
- **H3, a value outside the options: shown.** On base the native control showed its first option:
  - `text` for a field typed `geo_point`;
  - "Default (System)" for the font `Georgia`;
  - "None" for the template `ghost`.
  The trigger now shows the value itself, and it is listed first. All three are pinned.
- **H4, first-load bytes: under the ceiling, +16 B gzip.**
  - Before the first edit, on base: `FieldDesigner`, `DataModelDesigner` and `AppCreationWizard` ship in the lazy `src-*.js` chunk that `index` reaches through `lazy(() => import(...))`. That chunk is not among the 336 members of `apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json`. `BrandingEditor` is in no console chunk at all: nothing in the console imports it. The eager closure was 3,391,326 B gzip and 11,496,190 B raw.
  - On head `cb7dd83aa`: 3,391,342 B gzip and 11,496,424 B raw, with 336 eager chunks. The delta is +16 B gzip and +234 B raw. The designer chunk is still lazy.
  - Local `pnpm check:eager-closure` prints "Console eager closure is 3311.9 KB gzipped across 336 of 2458 chunks (budget: 3312.0 KB, headroom: 0.1 KB)". The headroom is 142 B against the 3,391,484 B ceiling.
  - What the 16 B is: the type filter's category headings. `vendor-radix` grows by 199 B raw (+27 B gzip), because Radix's group and label parts now reach the eager closure.
  - A measured variant with the headings removed (the filter as a flat list) reads 3,391,325 B gzip, which is -1 B against base, so byte-neutral. It was run once, and the file was restored to HEAD (blob proven, `git diff HEAD` empty). It is not on this branch. The headings were kept because the native control had them. Dropping them is the byte-neutral fallback if the seat wants every byte.

## Evidence (head `cb7dd83aa`)

- Tests: `pnpm exec vitest run` from the repo root, under the container's verify lock.
  - Scope: the whole `packages/plugin-designer/` (every suite that mounts the four components), plus `packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/column-identity.ratchet.test.ts` and `scripts/__tests__/one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts`.
  - Result: `Test Files 46 passed (46)`, `Tests 423 passed (423)`.
- Reverse leg, run from the committed head:
  - The four source files were put back on base's blobs, proven by hash on disk, and the new pin was run: `Tests 91 failed` of its 98.
  - The 7 green pins are the kept-behaviour pins: the two names, the three read-only states, the read-only type text, and the field-type picker's own keys. That last one is green on base because the native control was a `SELECT`, which the guard already skipped.
  - The files were restored with `git checkout HEAD`. Each blob equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` was empty.
- Ablations of the two companions, each through `ablation-replace.mjs`, each restore proven by blob hash:
  - the guard's combobox line removed: `Tests 1 failed | 97 passed`, and the failure is the keys pin;
  - the list's click stop removed: `1 failed | 97 passed`, the card pin;
  - the trigger's click stop removed: `1 failed | 97 passed`, the card pin.
  - The first attempt at the list ablation deleted the whole opening tag. That is a syntax error, and no tests ran, so it is not a reading. It was redone as a replacement.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-designer type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0.
  - It ran after building the `@object-ui/plugin-designer^...` closure (16 packages built).
  - `--listFilesOnly` on the test tsconfig lists all three touched suites.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the seven touched files: 0 errors and 15 warnings.
  - Per file, each count equals that file's base blob: `FieldDesigner` 2, `DataModelDesigner` 11, `AppCreationWizard` 2, the rest 0.
  - The new pin reads 0 and 0.
- Gates, each exit 0:
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`;
  - `pnpm check:new-line-citations` ("0 new citation(s)"), `pnpm check:control-bytes`;
  - `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`;
  - `check:i18n-keys`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unused-deps`.

## Docs

No package README or `content/docs` guide names these four controls, so the docs-driven rule has nothing to update.

## Acceptance notes

- One display change, described in the changeset: a value none of a picker's options carries now shows as itself (H3).
- First-load bytes: +16 B gzip, all of it for the type filter's category headings (H4). The flat-list variant is measured at -1 B if the seat prefers it.
- Not changed, observed: the type filter and the field-type picker have no accessible name, on base and on head. Giving them one needs a label string, and that is outside this control swap. Noted, not filed.
- Not changed, observed: `BrandingEditor` reaches no console chunk; only the package entry exports it.
- Not changed, observed: a comment in `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/addRowCreatePermissionGate.test.tsx` cites a line of `FieldDesigner` by number. The citation was already off on base. This PR does not touch that file.
- The card stays open: the other native selects on it are not touched here. Slices h and i of the same claim are separate PRs.
